meta.title: Nata · Send items with travelers already making the trip

hero.subtitle: Nata connects people who need an item carried to another city with verified travelers who are already flying there. Send one request to up to 5 travelers, pay a small flat fee for those who accept, and agree on the price together in the chat.

fee.label: Nata fee, only if a traveler accepts

how.title: One app, two simple roles
how.subtitle: Anyone can browse. Senders and travelers share one account.

sender.title: Senders
sender.description: Find travelers on your route, send them one request, and agree on the price in the chat.
features: Search trips by route and arrival date
One request to up to 5 travelers going to the same city
A flat Nata fee only for travelers who accept

steps.title: Search for a traveler
steps.text: Pick a departure and destination and the latest date the item should arrive. Filter by the weight you need to send.

steps.title: Check their profile
steps.text: See ratings, completed deliveries, verification, capacity, upcoming trips and reviews from past senders.

steps.title: Send one request
steps.text: Say what you're sending, add its weight and photos, and tick up to 5 travelers going to the same city. You see Nata's fee for each one.

steps.title: Get an answer within 48 hours
steps.text: When a traveler accepts, you have 24 hours to pay their Nata fee. You pay nothing for travelers who don't accept.

steps.title: Check the ticket and pay the fee
steps.text: Review the traveler's flight ticket, then pay by card, Apple Pay or mobile money. Paying opens the chat.

steps.title: Agree on the price and the handover
steps.text: In the chat, agree on the price and pay the traveler directly. Meet somewhere busy and public, and check the traveler's ID matches the ticket.

steps.title: Confirm and rate
steps.text: From the trip's arrival day, Nata asks whether your item was delivered. Confirm it and leave a review.

traveler.title: Travelers
traveler.description: Post a trip you're taking anyway, carry items for people on your route and agree on your price with them.
features: Identity verified once with ID and selfie
Choose how much weight and what size you carry
Agree on the price in the chat and get paid directly

steps.title: Verify your identity
steps.text: Upload an ID document and a selfie. A face match verifies you in moments.

steps.title: Post your trip
steps.text: Add your route, dates, maximum weight and size, and your flight ticket. Your booking reference is always blurred for senders.

steps.title: Review incoming requests
steps.text: See the sender, the items and their photos before you decide.

steps.title: Accept or decline
steps.text: Carry up to 3 deliveries per trip, each from a different sender. Once you accept, the sender pays Nata's fee and the chat opens.

steps.title: Agree on the price
steps.text: In the chat, agree on the price and the handover. The sender pays you directly, and Nata's cost calculator can suggest a fair price.

steps.title: Pick up the item
steps.text: Meet the sender in a public place and take a photo of the item.

steps.title: Hand over and confirm
steps.text: Hand over the item as you agreed, then tap I delivered it. You and the sender can then review each other.

why.title: Built for trust on both sides
why.subtitle: Every step is designed so senders and travelers can trust each other.

fee.title: One small flat fee
fee.text: Senders pay Nata only for travelers who accept. If the traveler cancels, the fee is refunded in full.

verified.title: Verified members
verified.text: Posting a trip or sending a request needs a passed ID and selfie check. Browsing stays open to all.

pricing.title: A price you agree together
pricing.text: Sender and traveler decide the price in the chat. Nata's cost calculator suggests a fair one from the distance and the weight.

checkin.title: Delivery check-ins
checkin.text: From the trip's arrival day, Nata asks both sides whether the item was delivered, then invites them to leave a review.

chat.title: Private chat
chat.text: Unlocks once Nata's fee is paid, only between the sender and traveler, and closes once the item is delivered.

reviews.title: Reviews both ways
reviews.text: Senders rate travelers and travelers rate senders. Reviews are public and can't be edited.

language.title: Your language, your currency
language.text: English, French and Spanish. Prices in USD, EUR, GBP or XOF.

notify.title: Always in the loop
notify.text: Notifications at every step: request accepted, fee paid, chat open, picked up and delivered.

rules.title: Simple, transparent rules
rules.subtitle: The numbers that shape every delivery on Nata.

items.label: Nata fee per traveler who accepts
For a traveler to answer a request
To pay Nata's fee once accepted
Nata asks if it was delivered, from the arrival day

cancel.title: Cancelling
cancel.text: Free until you pay Nata's fee. Once it's paid the chat is open, so the fee isn't refunded if you cancel. If the traveler cancels, it's refunded in full.

fees.title: What Nata's fee costs
fees.note: Per traveler who accepts. It follows the country you live in and whether the trip stays in one country.

payments.title: Pay Nata's fee your way
payments.subtitle: The right method is chosen for you based on where you live. The delivery price goes straight to the traveler.

card.title: Card & Apple Pay
card.text: Paid securely through Stripe in a payment sheet inside the app, or by card through Flutterwave for members in Nigeria. Your card details never reach Nata.

mobile.title: Mobile money
mobile.text: Through pawaPay, with no page to leave: pick your network or a saved wallet, enter your number and approve the prompt on your phone with your PIN.

direct.title: Paying the traveler
direct.text: You and the traveler agree on the price and how to pay in the chat, and you pay them directly. Nata doesn't hold this money.

safety.title: Safety comes first
safety.subtitle: Clear habits that keep every handover safe.

items.title: Meet in public
items.text: Pickups and handovers always happen somewhere busy: an airport, a station, a café. Never at a private address.

items.title: Check the ticket and ID
items.text: Senders see the traveler's flight ticket before paying Nata's fee, and check their ID matches it in person.

items.title: Private details stay private
items.text: Booking references and barcodes are blurred. Requests can't contain phone numbers or other contact details.

items.title: Report a problem
items.text: If something goes wrong, report the member from the chat or email support. Our team follows up.

items.a: You and the traveler, together in the chat. Nata's cost calculator (Profile › Estimate a delivery) suggests a fair price from the distance and the weight, but neither of you has to use it.
A flat fee for each traveler who accepts, paid by the sender. It depends on where you live and whether the trip stays in one country: see the table above.

items.q: How does the traveler get paid?
items.a: Directly by the sender, the way you agree in the chat. Nata doesn't hold the delivery price.

items.q: Can I send one request to several travelers?
items.a: Yes, to up to 5 travelers going to the same city. You pay Nata's fee only for those who accept.
Yes. It's free until you pay Nata's fee. After that the fee isn't refunded if you cancel, but it's refunded in full if the traveler cancels.

items.q: Do I need to verify my identity?
items.a: To post a trip or send a request, yes: an ID document and a selfie. You can browse and search without an account.

items.q: What if my item doesn't arrive?
items.a: Report the member from the chat or email support with the route and date, and our team follows up. Because you pay the traveler directly, Nata can't refund the delivery price.

cta.subtitle: Join travelers and senders already moving parcels between cities with Nata.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what information Nata collects when you use the Nata app and the website nata-app.com, why we collect it, who we share it with, and the choices you have.

sections.title: Who we are
items: Nata connects people who need an item carried to another city with verified travelers already making the trip.
For any question about this policy or your information, email support@nata-app.com.

sections.title: Information we collect
items: Account: your phone number, name, profile photo, country of residence, language and currency.
Identity check: a photo of your ID document, a selfie and the result of the face match, plus an emergency contact.
Trips: routes, dates, the weight and size you can carry, and your flight ticket.

Deliveries: item descriptions and photos, and pickup and handover photos. Requests sent before November 2026 may also hold a recipient's name and phone number, a delivery code, item values and receipts.
Messages: what you write and the photos you send in delivery chats.

Payments and payouts: amounts, method and status. Card details are handled by Stripe or Flutterwave and never reach Nata, and Stripe keeps any cards you save. We keep your saved mobile money numbers and, for payouts on older requests, the last 4 digits of your bank account. What you pay a traveler directly doesn't go through Nata.
Reviews, problem reports and suggestions you send us.
Device: a push-notification token and the app version, so we can send you updates.

sections.title: How we use it
items: To match senders with travelers and run each delivery, from request to handover.
To verify identities and keep the community safe.
To process Nata's fees and refunds, and the payments and payouts of older requests.
To send notifications, including asking whether an item was delivered, and a recipient's delivery code by SMS on older requests.
To provide support, handle reported problems and improve Nata.

sections.title: What other members see
items: Your first name and last initial, your photo, your verification status, ratings and reviews.
Senders see a copy of the traveler's ticket with the booking reference and barcodes blurred.
Travelers never see a recipient's phone number. On older requests, recipients see the traveler's first name, photo, rating and route through their private link.
Chats are only visible to the two people in that delivery.

sections.title: Who we share it with
items: Supabase stores Nata's data; Vercel hosts this website.
Amazon Web Services (Rekognition) compares your selfie with your ID photo.
Stripe processes card and Apple Pay payments and bank payouts; pawaPay processes mobile money payments and payouts; Flutterwave processes card payments and bank payouts for members in Nigeria.
Bird sends SMS messages; Firebase Cloud Messaging delivers push notifications.
These providers only process information to provide their service to Nata. We may also share information when the law requires it.
We never sell your personal data.

sections.title: How long we keep it
items: We keep your information while your account is open.

When you delete your account it closes straight away: pending requests are cancelled and upcoming trips are removed. You have 7 days to restore it by signing in; after that, your personal data is erased.
Some records, such as payment records, may be kept for as long as the law requires.

sections.title: Your choices
items: You can see and update your profile and preferences in the app at any time.
You can delete your account in the app (Profile › Delete account) once no money or delivery is in progress.
To ask about, correct or delete your information, email support@nata-app.com.

sections.title: Security
items: Information travels over encrypted connections. Access to members' data is restricted, and Nata's staff tools only show what's needed to help.

sections.title: This website
items: The website remembers your language choice in your browser. Signing in keeps a session in your browser until you sign out.
We don't use advertising or tracking cookies.

sections.title: Children
items: Nata is intended for adults. Posting a trip or sending a request requires a valid ID.

sections.title: Changes
items: We'll update this page when our practices change, and change the date at the top.

support.title: Help & support
support.intro: Answers to the most common questions about sending and carrying items with Nata. If you can't find what you need, our team is a message away.
support.emailNote: Write in English, French or Spanish. Include the phone number of your Nata account and, for a delivery, the route and date.

topics.title: Signing in
items: Nata signs you in with your phone number and a 6-digit code sent by SMS.
No code? Check the number and country code, make sure you have network coverage, then tap Resend after 60 seconds.
You can correct your name in Profile until your identity check starts. After that it must match your ID, and only support can change it.

topics.title: Verifying your identity
items: Posting a trip or sending a request needs a passed identity check: a photo of your ID and a selfie.
If your check is still under review, open Profile › Identity verification and choose Finish with a face scan.
You'll also be asked for an emergency contact. It's never shown to other members and is only used by support if we can't reach you.

topics.title: Sending an item
items: Search by route and the latest date your item should arrive, then send one request to up to 5 verified travelers going to the same city.

Each traveler has 48 hours to answer. When one accepts, you have 24 hours to pay their Nata fee, which opens the chat. There you agree on the price and the handover, and you pay the traveler directly.
Cancelling is free until you pay Nata's fee. After that the fee isn't refunded if you cancel.

topics.title: Payments and refunds
items: Nata's fee is paid by card or Apple Pay through Stripe, by mobile money through pawaPay, or by card through Flutterwave for members in Nigeria.
The fee depends on the country you live in and whether the trip stays in one country. You see it before you send a request.
If the traveler cancels, the fee is refunded the way you paid. A payment made twice is refunded in full.
Save cards and mobile money wallets in Profile › Payment methods. Nata no longer has a wallet balance.

topics.title: Carrying items and getting paid
items: Post a trip you're already taking with your flight ticket, maximum weight and size. You can carry up to 3 deliveries per trip.
You and the sender agree on the price in the chat, and the sender pays you directly. Nata's fee is paid by the sender.
Profile › Estimate a delivery suggests a fair price from the distance and the weight. It's only a guide.

topics.title: Handover and confirming delivery
items: Always meet in a busy public place, never at a private address.
Once the item is handed over, the traveler taps I delivered it and the sender confirms. For three days from the arrival day, Nata asks both of them whether it was delivered.
Requests sent before November 2026 still end with the recipient's 4-digit code. After 5 wrong codes, the delivery is locked: contact support to unlock it.

topics.title: Reporting a problem
items: If something goes wrong, report the member from the chat or email us with the route and date. Our team follows up on every report.
On requests sent before November 2026, you can also report a problem from Confirm receipt for 3 days after delivery.

topics.title: Deleting your account
items: Open Profile › Delete account in the app. Your account closes straight away, and your data is erased after 7 days. Sign in within those 7 days to restore it.
It isn't possible while money or a delivery is in progress: money held by Nata, a payout or refund not settled yet, a request that is accepted, paid or picked up, or an open problem report.
When you delete your account, pending requests are cancelled and upcoming trips are removed.

deleteAccount.title: Delete your Nata account
deleteAccount.intro: You can delete your Nata account and the data linked to it at any time, in the Nata app or by email. This applies to the Nata app on Android and iOS.
appSteps: Open the Nata app and sign in.
Confirm. Your account closes straight away, and its data is erased after 7 days.
emailSteps: Email {email} from your own email address.
Use the subject “Delete my Nata account” and give the phone number of your account, with its country code.
We confirm the request with you, then delete your account and tell you when it's done.
deleteAccount.emailBody:
Hello Nata team,

Please delete my Nata account and its data.

Phone number on my account (with country code): 

Thank you.
beforeItems: An account can't be deleted while money or a delivery is in progress: money held by Nata, a payout or refund not settled yet, a request that is accepted, paid or picked up, or an open problem report.
Finish or cancel those first. If you're stuck, email us and we'll help.
You can restore your account by signing in within the 7 days. After that, the deletion can't be undone.
deleteAccount.dataIntro: Your account and the data linked to it are deleted, including:
dataItems: Your profile: name, phone number, profile photo, country, language and currency.
Your identity check: ID document photo, selfie and face-match result, and your emergency contact.
Your trips, delivery requests, item photos and any recipient details on older requests.
Your messages and the photos you sent in chats.
Saved payment methods and payout accounts.
deleteAccount.dataNote: Open requests are cancelled and upcoming trips are removed when your account is deleted.
